name: Nutan Sarawagi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nutan Sarawagi writes in Hindi and English. Her contributor biographies in Different Truths and the Inner Child Press anthology The Heart of a Poet connect her writing with a background in education and professional design. They also describe a sustained concern for women, children and those affected by war. Her attention to the colour and movement of language is evident in the Hindi poem presented here.

Alfazon Se Nikle Do Shabd makes words themselves speak: they laugh, cry, fail to be understood and grow afraid of their own expression. The plea to be allowed to speak gradually becomes a way of examining the self and recognising another person. By the closing movement, ink and new colours make writing an act of renewed understanding, with a story taking shape between speaker and listener.
